methodology: Publicly listed view counts (Digital Creators). Titles and metadata reviewed; no claim of shot-by-shot video access. Editing hypotheses are inspired by topic/format and YouTube Shorts creator guidance, not reverse-engineered proven causal factors.
inclusion_rule: Use >=3 actual food-related videos independently reported at >=1,000,000 views before selecting a creative treatment; show views, date and source.

creative_rules: Use an appetizing real photo on frame 1; do not show a generic logo first.
Display a short concrete visual hook in <=1 second.
Use cut pacing (~1–2s) to avoid a long static slideshow.
Show variety and/or a progression; final shot has satisfying close-up.
Never borrow the original creator's footage, audio, thumbnails, or copy text.
Every photo must have documented license metadata; no client endorsement implied.
Real cooking motion footage is necessary before claiming competitive commercial production quality.
disclaimer: Viral views are not guaranteed; public aggregate counts can change. These are design hypotheses rather than demonstrated causation.
